title: First CFD-firm tests on Dukascopy hourly data (US100, US500, US30, DE40, XAUUSD, EURUSD, 2013-01..2026-09)
registered: 2026-10-15, after the 6 hourly files arrived and before any Gen73 number was computed
data: research_data/dukascopy/<SYM>_1h.parquet, BID prices, UTC bar-open times; converted to New York / London time where a rule says so (DST-aware)

costs.spread_commission_per_side: indices 1.0 bp (US100/US500/US30/DE40), XAUUSD 2.0 bp, EURUSD 1.0 bp (spread + commission at FTMO-type firms); stress 2x
costs.financing: 3%/yr on notional for positions held over 22:00 UTC (CFD swap), charged per night held; intraday-only rules pay none
costs.note: real ask-side spreads by hour arrive later (Dukascopy ASK pass) and will be used to re-check any pass

splits: DEV 2013-2019 | TEST 2020-2023 | HOLD 2024-2026 (Gen60 Dukascopy splits); Gen59 re-tests are judged on the FRESH period 2023-10..2026-09 only
pass_new: TEST >= 0.8 and HOLD >= 0.5 and DEV > 0, worst day >= -1.5% at 10% vol, AND (portfolio check) correlation with crypto v5 <= 0.3
pass_retest: Gen59 rule: fresh-period Sharpe > 0.5 after costs AND same sign as the original result

T1 gold session split (Gen60 D2, frozen).rule: XAUUSD: long 23:00-07:00 UTC, short 07:00-16:00 UTC, flat otherwise; unit notional; 2 bp per side per leg; neither leg is held over 22:00 UTC, so no swap

T2 Gen59 re-test: European-open long (Ge.rule: US500 and DE40: long 23:30-03:30 New York time. Hourly data: enter at the open of the 00:00 NY bar, exit at the open of the 04:00 NY bar (same 4 hours, shifted 30 min). 1 bp per side; no swap (04:00-09:00 UTC, does not cross 22:00 UTC)

T3 Gen59 re-test: overnight index return.rule: US500, US100, US30: long from the open of the 16:00 NY bar to the open of the 09:00 NY bar (hourly stand-in for close-to-open), 1 bp per side, one night of financing (3%/yr / 365)

T4 Gen59 re-test: noise-area breakout (G.rule: as Gen47 (14-day band, VWAP replaced by the session's typical-price average, 2% daily vol target, max 4x), but checks every hour instead of every 30 min (hourly data deviation, fixed here); flat at the 16:00 NY close; 1 bp per side

T5 4h breakout trend on the 6 CFDs (new;.rule: 4-hour bars (UTC 00/04/08/12/16/20): long on close > highest high of the previous 20 bars, short on close < lowest low of 20, exit long on close < lowest low of 10, exit short on close > highest high of 10; each instrument at 10% vol (6 x 30 4h-bar trailing vol, cap 2x), equal weight across the 6; costs per instrument + 3%/yr financing on held notional
